words.gloss: they will not shake or flick

literal: Wet hand will not shake base people jaw breaking clenched-fisted-ones except to those.
translation: Mean people will not even shake the leftover food from their wet hands for anyone, except for those who would break their jaws with a clenched fist.
modern: கயவர்கள் தங்களுக்குக் குத்துவிடக் கை ஓங்கும் வன்முறையாளர்களுக்கு அன்றி, மற்றவர்களுக்குத் தாங்கள் சாப்பிட்டு முடித்த ஈரக் கையைக்கூட உதற மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet satirizes the nature of base or mean-minded people. They are so utterly miserly that they will not even shake the moisture or leftover food grains from their wet hands to help a needy person. However, they will readily yield and give away everything to those who threaten them with clenched fists and are ready to break their jaws. The poet contrasts the utter stinginess of the base towards the polite with their instant submission to physical force.
